svg.title: Step 4: identity and Agent Gateway checks
svg.text: ID token for its own principal
can this agent identity reach it?
ALLOW HRIS, ticketing, Google APIs · DENY compensation
Default deny: unregistered or unlisted destinations
Owners: the security team writes the policy; the agent
team registers its tools; the customer's IAM admins
Ingress mode (CLIENT_TO_AGENT) puts a gateway in front
of the agent instead: Model Armor on queries.
